requirements.text: * Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Core Java and full\-stack application development, Object\-oriented analysis and design techniques, experience with REST APIs
* Hands\-on practical experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle, including system design, application development, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and operational support.

* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical plans. (e.g. working collaboratively in agile teams and participating in Scrum ceremonies, stand\-ups, retrospectives, sprint planning…)
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Experience in writing and maintaining comprehensive unit, functional, and integration tests.
* Experience implementing observability practices including monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SLO/SLA management.
* Experience building event\-driven systems and distributed architectures using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Experience integrating operational and investment data platforms through APIs, event streams, and data pipelines.

* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.

* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation**.**
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies, eg. REACT
* Hands\-on exposure to AWS cloud services and ecosystems
* AWS Certified (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer, etc.)
* Financial Services experience. Working knowledge of Fund Administration, Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency, Custody, Investment Operations, or Asset Management platforms
